findings.finding: Full table scan on accounts table with no index. Pattern: SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE status = ?
findings.recommendation: Add index on status column. Use SELECT id, name FROM accounts WHERE status = ? LIMIT 100 with cursor pagination.
findings.estimated_runtime_impact: High — full scan on 2.4M row table adds ~340ms per call at current load. At AI delivery scale, this compounds across every generated service test.

findings.finding: N+1 query pattern in payment loop. getPaymentById() called inside loop over transaction list.
findings.recommendation: Replace with batch query: getPaymentsByIds(transactionIds). Reduces DB round trips from N to 1.
findings.estimated_runtime_impact: High — 47 DB calls per payment batch instead of 1. Projected 12x energy overhead under load.

findings.finding: getAccountPolicy() called on every request with no cache. Policy data changes at most daily.
findings.recommendation: Cache policy result with TTL of 1 hour using @Cacheable. Eliminates ~95% of policy DB calls.
findings.estimated_runtime_impact: Medium — policy retrieval adds 18ms per call. With caching, reduces to ~0.2ms average.

findings.finding: Batch report generation runs synchronously in request thread. Processing 500+ records per request.
findings.recommendation: Move batch processing to async job queue. Return job ID immediately; poll for completion.
findings.estimated_runtime_impact: Medium — blocks request thread for 2-8s per report. Reduces peak compute by ~40% under async.

findings.finding: Account object serialized to JSON and immediately deserialized in same method call. Round-trip with no transformation.
findings.recommendation: Pass the object directly. Remove unnecessary serialize/deserialize cycle.
findings.estimated_runtime_impact: Low — ~3ms overhead per notification. High call frequency (1,200/day) makes this worth fixing.

findings.finding: Full legacy codebase context (89K tokens) sent on every BuildAgent retry. Context does not change between retries.
findings.recommendation: Cache architecture context hash. Only re-send context if hash changes. Estimated 60K token saving per retry.
findings.estimated_runtime_impact: High — 3 retries × 89K tokens = 267K tokens of repeated context. Prompt compression saves ~$8 and 0.21 kg CO₂e per workflow run.
